input_and_tokenizer_contract.permitted_context: Only declared board context; no network lookup, news, price, company fact, or author metadata.

tokenization_execution.duplicate_cls_sep_prevention: manual assembly inserts exactly one CLS and three SEP; component calls with add_special_tokens=true are forbidden
tokenization_execution.token_type_ids: NOT_EMITTED_NOT_INFERRED_NOT_SILENTLY_DROPPED; separator IDs carry segment boundaries across candidates

input_and_tokenizer_contract.missing_stock_context: Represent a missing stock_code or stock_name as its empty delimited segment and record the missing-field flag; model_text may not be empty.

max_length.selection_rule: Owner selects only after the approved candidate tokenizer produces Train/Dev/Test/Anchor and challenge token-length coverage; no character-length proxy is used.

segment_token_budgets.impact: without caps and max_length the builder cannot claim truncation coverage or become fully frozen

truncation.head_tail_algorithm: retain ceil(remaining_body_token_budget/2) leading plus floor(remaining_body_token_budget/2) trailing model_text IDs with no inserted token
truncation.rule: Compare with the same approved tokenizer and record the exact policy in every training, evaluation, export, and inference manifest.

input_and_tokenizer_contract.padding: DYNAMIC_RIGHT_PADDING_TO_BATCH_LONGEST_WITH_ATTENTION_MASK; padding_side is right and export/inference must preserve padding-side and mask behavior.
input_and_tokenizer_contract.parity_requirement: The exact versioned input builder, tokenizer revision, tokenizer file hashes, normalization, max length, truncation, padding, and attention-mask contract are shared by train, Dev, Test, Gold, OOD, export, and inference.

shared_encoder_architecture.representation: single shared final-layer last_hidden_state[:, 0, :] representation; do not use pretrained pooler output
shared_encoder_architecture.head_depth: one affine projection per head after shared dropout

loss_weight_separation.sample_field_weight: immutable sample_id x prediction_head weight; multiply only that sample/head loss
loss_weight_separation.head_loss_weight: explicit per-head scalar in a new experiment config; default candidate is 1.0 for each head and is not a sample confidence
loss_weight_separation.class_weight: explicit per-class or Reasoning positive-class loss coefficient; disabled unless a documented Dev ablation supports it; never replaces either other weight

shared_encoder_architecture.single_task_control: M2: train each head with a separate candidate Encoder configuration and equivalent data/split budget for negative-transfer comparison; not an M1 first-run gate.
shared_encoder_architecture.multi_task_control: M1: one shared Encoder with seven frozen heads. M2: report all field, class, calibration, OOD, and resource trade-offs against single-task controls.
shared_encoder_architecture.negative_transfer_rule: A pooled score cannot hide a material regression on a scalar head, critical semantic boundary, calibration, abstention, or worst seed.

probability_abstention_and_ood_contract.probabilities: retain full ordered class probability vectors for each scalar head and a 15-label probability vector for Reasoning before any thresholding
probability_abstention_and_ood_contract.abstention: per-head, versioned, calibrated on Dev only, and never remapped to UNKNOWN, NEUTRAL, NONE_EXPLICIT, or NO_ACTION_SIGNAL
probability_abstention_and_ood_contract.reasoning_thresholds: one threshold per tag or a documented global threshold, calibrated on Dev and saved with class order; no forced tag on an OOD or abstained record
probability_abstention_and_ood_contract.ood: explicitly separate from UNKNOWN and low confidence; requires a reason code and a validated score before any production claim

common_controls.role_separation: Train uses weighted weak labels; Dev is for early stopping/threshold/calibration; Test and Anchor are diagnostic-only until independent Gold and OOD are approved.

B_partial_unfreeze.encoder_parameters: unfreeze final 2_to_4_layers as an explicit experiment parameter

C_full_finetuning.entry_gate: Only after A/B evidence and an owner-approved Gold plan support it.

evaluation_contract.selection_rule: No model name, single aggregate score, or single favourable seed decides selection.
evaluation_contract.candidate_threshold_status: The archived v0.1 numerical thresholds remain provisional and cannot become a production gate until owner approval and an independent adjudicated Gold set exist.

gold_ood_and_llm_review_protocol.anchor_warning: Anchor50 has 11 HUMAN_CONFIRMED and 39 EXPERT_PREADJUDICATED rows; it is not independent final Gold.

resource_and_export_contract.cpu_support: mandatory for inference; accelerator may not be the only executable route
resource_and_export_contract.retention_rule: Retain selected weights, tokenizer files, model configuration, license copy, file hashes, resolved revision, and immutable export manifest in approved artifact storage; do not commit weights/checkpoints/runs to ordinary Git.

owner_authorization_checklist: Approve one or more candidate model IDs and their exact revisions/licenses.
Approve downloading the selected weights and tokenizer artifacts from the listed official source.
Approve installation or use of PyTorch and Transformers in a named project runtime.
Choose CPU-only, MPS, Linux CUDA, or a multi-target support policy.
Set model-size, artifact-retention, training-time, and cost budgets.
Choose maximum sequence length only after a real tokenizer-length audit.
Approve independent Gold target quantity and adjudication protocol.
Approve OOD set size, source policy, and challenge taxonomy.
Decide whether limited LLM review is allowed, provider/model/privacy controls, and budget.
Authorize the next experiment stage and its training resources; this does not authorize 49,054-row production inference.
